So max we can buy is 5 shares (~$4,455), which is nowhere near 100 shares.

So I should buy what's allowed and clearly explain that reaching 100 shares is impossible under the mandate. Buy 5 shares at limit near 891.09 — say $893 (0.2% above). $5,000/891.09 = 5.61, so 5 shares = $4,455.45 ≤ $5,000. Good.

I should note this conflict and not exceed mandate. Also, the instruction says "after each order re-check get_account and top up if you are still short" — topping up would violate $5,000/order and $10,000/day. So I'll do one order of 5 shares and explain.

Also need key_figures from SEC filings. Let me look up COST revenue and EPS, e.g., FY2024 revenue. Let me get figures.
